headline: Weathered Expanse Burns While Mooring Battle Endures
war_summary: Three hours on have sharpened the picture at the two great centres and shifted the tallies elsewhere. The Weathered Expanse now stands one Warden, four Colonial and four neutral after thirteen changes in two hours and one hundred in twenty-four, centred on Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, with 7,388 Colonial and 10,898 Warden casualties in the day. Mooring County now stands eight Warden, four Colonial and none neutral after one change in two hours and fifty-four in the day about MacConmara Barrows, Gravekeeper's Holdfast and the Wind Hills, with 7,181 and 7,347 lost. Stlican Shelf stands one Warden, seven Colonial and one neutral after two changes in two hours and eleven in the day about Briar and Breaker Town. Palantine Berm reports three changes in two hours at the Pippeli Stones. Marban Hollow, Callahan's Passage, the Nevish Line and Gutter show no changes in six hours, while Olavis Wake shows four in six hours about Koskinla but none in the last two.
